import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import norm, t, skewnorm

strategies = [
    {"title": "Aggressive 4th-Down", "family": "normal", "params": {"mu": 0.45, "sigma": 0.153}}, 
    {"title": "Pre-Snap Motion", "family": "normal", "params": {"mu": 0.3, "sigma": 0.102}},
    {"title": "Red Zone Blitz", "family": "student_t", "params": {"nu": 4.0, "mu": 0.1, "sigma": 0.180}},
    {"title": "Fatigue Tempo Pivot", "family": "skew_normal", "params": {"xi": 0.05, "omega": 0.25, "alpha": 2.0}},
    {"title": "Position-less Chaos", "family": "skew_normal", "params": {"xi": 0.0, "omega": 0.4, "alpha": 3.0}},
    {"title": "Free-Roaming Safety", "family": "student_t", "params": {"nu": 7.0, "mu": 0.05, "sigma": 0.275}}
]

fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(15, 10))
axes = axes.flatten()

for i, strat in enumerate(strategies):
    ax = axes[i]
    p = strat['params']
    
    # Generate x range
    x = np.linspace(-1.5, 1.5, 500)
    
    if strat['family'] == 'normal':
        dist = norm(p['mu'], p['sigma'])
        pdf = dist.pdf(x)
        low, high = dist.ppf(0.025), dist.ppf(0.975)
        mode = p['mu']
    elif strat['family'] == 'student_t':
        dist = t(p['nu'], p['mu'], p['sigma'])
        pdf = dist.pdf(x)
        low, high = dist.ppf(0.025), dist.ppf(0.975)
        mode = p['mu']
    elif strat['family'] == 'skew_normal':
        dist = skewnorm(p['alpha'], p['xi'], p['omega'])
        pdf = dist.pdf(x)
        low, high = dist.ppf(0.025), dist.ppf(0.975)
        # Approx mode for skewnorm
        mode = dist.mean() # Simplified for plotting marker

    ax.plot(x, pdf, lw=2)
    ax.fill_between(x, pdf, where=(x >= low) & (x <= high), alpha=0.3)
    ax.axvline(mode, color='red', linestyle='--', label='Mode')
    ax.set_title(strat['title'])
    ax.set_xlabel('Change in own scoring margin (points)')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

strategies.rationale: Analytics models consistently show that punting or kicking field goals in these scenarios significantly decreases expected points and win probability. While the risk of a turnover on downs exists, the point-differential gain over a full season is statistically undeniable.
strategies.recommendation: Adopt a protocol to go for it on 4th & 2 or less anywhere past the 40-yard line, and 4th & 4 or less in the opponent's territory inside the 4th quarter.
strategies.title: Hyper-Aggressive 4th-Down Conversion

strategies.title: Maximal Pre-Snap Motion
